verdict.rationale: LocalAI is a self-hosted runtime. Its docs show it running on your own machine at localhost and deployable via Docker, so you decide where data lives by deciding where you run it. However, the evidence never explicitly addresses where data is stored or how to configure that location. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of where data, models and chat history are stored, configurable storage paths or locations, any stated residency or no-telemetry guarantee, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: You can use it with any OpenAI SDK or client by pointing it to http://localhost:8080.
It answers questions, reads your files and runs commands on your machine
